title: Goldwyn (non) follies

choice.name: Three Spirit Livener
choice.note: watermelon, ginseng, guayusa, wild herbs, hibiscus, and pepper

steps: Mix the gin or Three Spirit Livener, cranberry juice, apple juice, black tea, cranberry-vanilla simple syrup, cinnamon stick, and apple slices. The black tea is brewed, chilled, and optionally vanilla flavored. Shake over ice.
